literal: If [one] estimates those who are like a hill so as to diminish [them], those who are like having stood [firmly] will perish on the earth along with [their] family.
translation: If one underestimates and disrespects those who are as great as a mountain, even those who seemed firmly established on this earth will perish along with their entire lineage.
modern: மலை போன்ற பெருமை உடையவர்களைக் குறைவாக மதித்து நடத்தினால், இவ்வுலகில் நிலைபெற்று வாழ்வது போல் தோன்றியவர்களும் தங்கள் குடும்பத்தோடு அழிந்து போவார்கள்.
explanation: This couplet warns against offending or disrespecting great people. The poet compares great people to a mountain (குன்று) in their stability, virtue, and stature. If anyone underestimates (குன்ற மதிப்பின்) or treats these mountain-like individuals with disrespect, the consequences are catastrophic. Even those who seemed firmly established and secure on this earth (நின்றன்னார்) will completely perish, not just individually, but along with their entire family or lineage (குடியொடு).
